title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Missing-Information Notices on Renewal Cases
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a renewal application that lacks any document type in its tier's required document list receives a missing-information notice listing each missing document, and the renewal case moves to pending documents.

**The missing-information notice of a renewal is sent only after the renewal case records the medical debt the renewal claims.** A renewal case whose medical debt still reads 0.00 records no claimed debt, and no missing-information notice goes out on it while it reads so.

## Sending the notice: `send_missing_information_notice_7f5665e5`

The agent unlocks `send_missing_information_notice_7f5665e5` and calls it. As a financial counselor's entry, it sends the missing-information notice on an incomplete financial assistance case: the case moves to pending documents and its documents due date is set to today plus the given number of calendar days; the notice is logged on the case, dated today, in the given language; and each document type marked as requested is logged on the case as requested, dated today. The patient can see the pending-documents status, the due date and the list of requested documents.

| Parameter | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `fap_case_id` | the reference number of the financial assistance case the notice is sent on, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for the patient | case id |
| `response_days` | the number of calendar days the patient is given; the due date is today's date plus that many calendar days, written YYYY-MM-DD | integer of at least 1 |
| `notice_language` | the language of the notice | English (preferred language English or not a letter language); Spanish; Hmong |
| `income_proof_request` | whether proof of income is on the list, a request being logged as pay stubs for the last 90 days | REQUESTED when no income document has been accepted on the case; NOT_REQUESTED when one has |
| `residency_request` | whether proof of residency is on the list | REQUESTED when no proof of residency has been accepted on the case; NOT_REQUESTED when one has |
| `outside_bills_request` | whether outside medical bills are on the list | REQUESTED when the tier requires outside medical bills and none have been accepted on the case; NOT_REQUESTED otherwise |
| `bank_statement_request` | whether a bank statement is on the list | REQUESTED when the tier requires a bank statement and none has been accepted on the case; NOT_REQUESTED otherwise |
| `medicaid_notice_request` | whether a BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) determination notice is on the list | REQUESTED when the tier requires a Medicaid determination notice and none has been accepted on the case; NOT_REQUESTED otherwise |

Return: "Missing-information notice <notice reference> sent on case <case> in <language>; documents due <due date YYYY-MM-DD>; requested: <comma list of requested document types, or none>." The receipt appearing means the case is pending documents with that due date.
